{{Top|leg}}
The '''Blade-36''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], presumably of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] manufacture, and successor of the [[Blade-28 fighter|Blade-28]], [[Blade-30 fighter|Blade-30]], [[Blade-32 superiority fighter|Blade-32]], and [[Blade-34 fighter|Blade-34]]. One was used in the [[Mission to save Kessel|mission]] to prevent the destruction of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].
